usageNotes: Use this to enumerate all CephFS file systems on a given Ceph cluster before mounting, configuring, or reporting on shared filesystem capacity. The cluster path parameter is the cluster's fsid (UUID-like string), not a human-readable name — retrieve it first from the cluster list endpoint. Each returned item includes both the primary data pool (for backward-compat) and the full data_pools array, which you should prefer when a filesystem uses multiple pools.

examples.summary: List all CephFS file systems on a known cluster

tips: A CephFS with multiple device-class-specific data pools will show them all in data_pools but only the first in data_pool — always prefer data_pools for complete pool accounting.
An empty array response means no CephFS file systems exist on this cluster yet; it does not indicate an error.
The cluster identifier is the Ceph fsid (a UUID), not the PDM cluster display name — check get_ceph_clusters if unsure.
